land_value_integrity.__comment: Config for the openavmkit.lvi battery. EVERY key is optional — omit it and it falls back to the Wake/IAAO default shown here. A new jurisdiction typically overrides only a few entries under `columns`, `vocab`, and `evidence.frozen_sov`; everything else can be deleted and will use these defaults.
land_value_integrity.__comment_model_group: Which model group to score. For multi-group jurisdictions, see `per_model_group` at the very bottom.

columns.__comment: Maps the battery's logical roles to YOUR column names. Defaults are openavmkit's canonical names (the assemble/clean pipeline already produces them), so list only the ones that differ in your data.
columns.__comment_series: The land series under test. FOR FLORIDA: map these to JUST (market) value land/building/total — NEVER the Save-Our-Homes-capped 'assessed value', or the tests measure the cap instead of the assessment.
columns.__comment_cost: Cost basis for the RCN-residual evidence streams and the depreciation diagnostic. `cost_bldg_value` = the cost-book depreciated building value (RCNLD). `pctgood` = percent-good (0-100 or 0-1; auto-detected). If `pctgood` is absent in your data, set it to null — the RCN streams degrade to vacant-only gold rather than breaking.
columns.__comment_sale_flags: `qualification` = the deed/sale qualification code column (Wake Disq_and_Qual; FL = DOR sale-qualification code). `vacant_sale` = boolean, true when the parcel sold as vacant land.
columns.__comment_canonical: The block above is openavmkit-canonical; the pipeline normalizes to these names, so you usually leave them as-is.
columns.__comment_impr_feats: A1 (improvement-independence) regresses land $/sqft on these building features. Use whatever building attributes your data carries.

vocab.__comment: The two things column-renaming can't fix: which sale codes count as qualified, and how to read zoning. These almost always need per-jurisdiction values.
vocab.__comment_qualified: WHITELIST of arm's-length deed codes for the land gold standard (non-circular). Wake = A/C. FLORIDA = the DOR qualified-sale codes (e.g. ['01','02']). Unstamped/NaN and all other codes are excluded — positive confirmation only.
vocab.__comment_resgroups: Model groups treated as residential for the prime-lot zoning filter.
vocab.__comment_classify_mode: 'regex' (Wake) OR 'set' (recommended elsewhere). 'set' = classify on a clean code column against an explicit residential allowlist. 'regex' = ordered pattern rules, for messy zoning vocabularies.
vocab.__comment_classify_field: Column to classify on. With mode 'set', point this at a clean code column — e.g. FL DOR use code 'dor_use_code' — rather than raw zoning.
vocab.__comment_residential_codes: Used ONLY when classify_mode='set': the residential allowlist (e.g. FL DOR ['0100','0200']). Everything else is treated as non-residential. Leave [] when using regex mode.
vocab.__comment_zoning_regex: Used ONLY when classify_mode='regex' (Wake default). Ordered [bucket, [patterns]] rules, evaluated top-down; first match wins, anything unmatched = 'other'. These are Wake/Raleigh's patterns verbatim — replace for your codes, or switch to 'set' mode.

prime_lot.__comment: Defines a 'prime buildable' comp: genuinely vacant, residentially zoned, locally comparable in size, sanely shaped. Tunable; Wake defaults shown.
prime_lot.__comment_rect: geom_rectangularity_num below this = weird/irregular shape, disqualified.
prime_lot.__comment_peers: A neighborhood needs at least this many BUILT peers to define a size band.
prime_lot.__comment_size: A vacant lot must fall within this percentile band of its neighborhood's built-lot sizes to be comparable.

evidence.__comment: How the evidence streams are gated. The frozen_sov flag is the key per-jurisdiction judgment.
evidence.__comment_frozen: TRUE only if building cost (RCN) comes from a frozen, publicly-adopted cost schedule (Wake's NC Schedule of Values). When true, depreciation~0 cost-residuals JOIN the A3 gold standard (~60x the vacant sample). Set FALSE if your cost basis isn't a trusted frozen schedule — gold then = prime+qualified vacant only.
evidence.__comment_rcn_gate: percent-good >= this => 'depreciation ~ 0' => the clean RCN-residual stream (assr_impr ~ RCN).
evidence.__comment_rcnld_gate: percent-good in [lo,hi) => the low/moderate-depreciation residual stream (reserved for external series, not the assessor's own gold).
evidence.__comment_teardown: A sale counts as a teardown only if its price/land-sqft is below this fraction of the neighborhood's developed $/land-sqft (priced like land, not a finished home).
evidence.__comment_floor: Drop vacant sales below this price (noise / token transfers).
evidence.__comment_clip: RCN reconstruction clamps percent-good to this range so a near-zero or wild over-100 factor can't manufacture an absurd RCN.

verdicts.__comment: pass/warn thresholds as [pass_at, warn_at]. Defaults are IAAO standards; override to retune. A metric better-when-LOW (COD, violations) passes at <= pass_at; better-when-HIGH (rho) passes at >= pass_at.
verdicts.__comment_a3: IAAO vacant-land COD band (very-active/large => 15, mid => 20, rural-depressed => 25).
verdicts.__comment_dep: Allowed residual-land drift ($/sqft) over 50 years of building age; ~0 = well-calibrated depreciation.

support.__comment: Coverage map (B1) and matched-building propagation (B1b) settings.
support.__comment_bpsf: Sane building $/sqft range when calibrating location-invariant building value for propagation.
support.__comment_anchor: A matched-building cluster needs this many anchor-zone sales before it can transfer a land level.

confidence.__comment: Per-parcel evidence-packet grading. A parcel is 'high' confidence when no sanity flags fire AND its land sits within these bands of the corroborating evidence.

land_value_integrity.__comment_per_group: OPTIONAL: multi-group jurisdictions can override any of the above per model group. Keys here win over the top-level block for that group.
